errors.text: The proposed material is a BCC/B2 refractory HEA rather than the as-cast FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA.
The hypothesized temperature window of 600–1100 °C and ODTT-controlled recovery does not reconstruct the target 550–750 °C brittle window, with minimum ductility near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.
The central mediator is assigned to B2 ordering and precipitate dissolution, whereas the target mechanism requires enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains together with jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries.
The cited evidence does not demonstrate a ductile-brittle-ductile aging transition in the proposed RHEA; it combines ordering simulations and mechanical observations from different alloy systems.
